questions.text: Which Spanish subject pronoun means «we» (a group of boys)?

feedback: Vosotros means you (plural, informal)

questions.solution: Nosotros = we; vosotros = you (plural, informal), ellos = they, usted = you (polite)
questions.hint: Its verb forms end in -mos

questions.text: What does «nunca» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.always: Always is siempre; nunca is a negative

questions.solution: Nunca = never, e.g. nunca como carne = I never eat meat
questions.hint: It is the opposite of siempre

questions.text: What does «nada» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Nada = nothing, e.g. no hago nada = I do nothing / I don't do anything
questions.hint: It is the opposite of algo (something)

questions.text: Give the «yo» form of «tener» in the present tense. Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Tener: tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tenéis, tienen
questions.hint: It is irregular in the yo form: it contains a g

questions.text: Give the «ellos» form of «ser» in the present tense. Type the verb only.

feedback.están: Están comes from estar; this question asks for ser

questions.solution: Ser: soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son
questions.hint: Ser is irregular; think of how you say «they are» for nationality

questions.text: Which word means «the» before a feminine plural noun such as «casas»?

feedback: Los is masculine plural
Unas means some

questions.solution: Las is the feminine plural article: las casas
questions.hint: Casas is feminine and plural

questions.text: Which word means «my» before a plural noun such as «hermanos»?

feedback: Mi is only used with singular nouns
Tus means your

questions.solution: Mis is used with plural nouns: mis hermanos
questions.hint: Hermanos is plural

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «___ problema es difícil.»

feedback: Problema is masculine even though it ends in -a
Problema is masculine, so una is wrong

questions.solution: Problema ends in -a but is masculine: el problema
questions.hint: Some nouns ending in -ma (from Greek) are masculine

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Madrid ___ en España.»

feedback: Ser is not used for where a place is; use estar

questions.solution: Location uses estar: Madrid está en España
questions.hint: Ser or estar? Think about which one is used for location

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include the definite article (el, la, los or las): the water

feedback.la agua: Agua is feminine, but it takes el because it starts with a stressed a-

questions.solution: Agua is feminine but takes el in the singular because it starts with a stressed a- (el agua fría)
questions.hint: Feminine nouns starting with a stressed a- sound take a different article in the singular

questions.text: Give the plural of «el lápiz», with its article.
questions.solution: Nouns ending in -z change z to c and add -es: los lápices
questions.hint: Words ending in -z change spelling in the plural, like la voz → las voces

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «Voy ___ cine.»

feedback: Cine is masculine, so a la is wrong
Del means of the or from the

questions.solution: Cine is masculine, and a + el = al: voy al cine
questions.hint: What happens when a meets el?

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «ser» or «estar»: «Hoy mi madre ___ cansada.» Type the verb only.

feedback.es: Temporary states and feelings like cansada use estar

questions.solution: Feelings and temporary states use estar: mi madre está cansada
questions.hint: Being tired is a temporary state

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «Mis hermanas son ___.» (tall)
questions.solution: Hermanas is feminine plural: altas
questions.hint: Hermanas is feminine and plural

questions.text: What does «Nunca como carne» mean?

options: I am not eating meat today
I eat a lot of meat

questions.solution: Nunca = never: I never eat meat
questions.hint: Look at the first word

questions.text: What does «Vamos a ver una película» mean?

options: We are going to watch a film
We would like to watch a film
We watch a film every day

questions.solution: Ir a + infinitive is the near future: we are going to watch a film
questions.hint: Vamos a + an infinitive talks about the future

questions.text: Read: «Ayer jugué al tenis con Pablo.» When did this happen? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Ayer means yesterday
questions.hint: Look at the first word of the sentence

questions.text: Read: «Lucía nunca bebe café.» What does Lucía never drink? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Café = coffee: Lucía never drinks coffee
questions.hint: Look at the noun after the verb bebe

questions.text: Which sentence is in the preterite (simple past)?

feedback: Comía is the imperfect (I used to eat / I was eating)

questions.solution: Comí is the preterite; como is present, comeré is future and comía is imperfect
questions.hint: The preterite yo form of -er verbs ends in an accented -í

questions.text: Read: «No me gusta nada el pescado.» What does the speaker dislike? Answer in English.
questions.solution: No me gusta nada el pescado = I don't like fish at all
questions.hint: Pescado is food from the sea or a river

questions.text: Complete with the preterite of «ir»: «Ayer mis padres ___ al mercado.» Type the verb only.

feedback.iban: Iban is the imperfect; a single completed action uses the preterite
feedback.fue: Fue is the él/ella form; mis padres needs the ellos form

questions.solution: Ir is irregular in the preterite: ellos fueron
questions.hint: In the preterite, ir has the same forms as ser

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «querer»: «Nosotros ___ ir a la playa.» Type the verb only.

feedback.quieremos: The e→ie change does not happen in the nosotros form

questions.solution: Querer changes e→ie, but not in the nosotros form: queremos
questions.hint: Stem-changing verbs do not change in the nosotros form

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Cuando era pequeño, ___ en el parque todos los días.»

feedback: Jugaban goes with ellos/ellas; the subject here is yo
Jugaré is the future
Juego is the present

questions.solution: A repeated past habit uses the imperfect, and the subject is yo: jugaba
questions.hint: Todos los días in the past describes a habit

questions.text: Choose the correct form: «A mi hermano le ___ los videojuegos.»

feedback: Gusta is for one thing; los videojuegos is plural

questions.solution: Gustar agrees with the thing liked; los videojuegos is plural: le gustan
questions.hint: With gustar, the verb agrees with the thing that is liked

questions.text: Complete with the future tense of «tener»: «El año que viene ___ un perro.» (yo) Type the verb only.

feedback.tendría: Tendría is the conditional (I would have)
feedback.teneré: Tener has an irregular future stem (tendr-)

questions.solution: Tener has the irregular future stem tendr-: tendré
questions.hint: Tener has an irregular future stem with a d in it

questions.text: Replace «la tele» with a pronoun: «Veo la tele.» → «___ veo.»

feedback: Lo replaces a masculine noun
Las replaces a feminine plural noun

questions.solution: La tele is feminine singular, so the direct object pronoun is la: la veo
questions.hint: Tele is feminine and it is the direct object

questions.text: Which sentence with «ser» or «estar» is correct?
questions.solution: A temporary state uses estar, and hermana is feminine: está enferma
questions.hint: Check ser or estar first, then the adjective ending

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «I would like to travel to Mexico»?

feedback: Going to a place uses a, not en
Voy a viajar means I am going to travel
Viajé means I travelled

questions.solution: Would like = me gustaría; travelling to a place uses a
questions.hint: Look for the conditional of gustar and the preposition for going to a place

questions.text: Which negative sentence is correct?
questions.solution: No goes before the auxiliary, and Spanish uses a double negative: no he comido nada
questions.hint: Spanish negatives go before haber and need nada, not algo

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using the preterite: «they ate»

feedback.comían: Comían is the imperfect (they used to eat)
feedback.ellos comían: Comían is the imperfect (they used to eat)

questions.solution: Preterite of comer with ellos: comieron
questions.hint: Use the ellos ending for -er verbs in the preterite

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using ir a + infinitive: «I am going to eat»

feedback.comeré: That is the simple future; this question asks for ir a + infinitive
feedback.voy comer: You need a between voy and the infinitive

questions.solution: Near future = ir + a + infinitive: voy a comer
questions.hint: Use the yo form of ir, then a, then the infinitive

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using the conditional: «we would go»

feedback.iremos: Iremos is the future (we will go)
feedback.íbamos: Íbamos is the imperfect (we used to go)

questions.solution: Conditional = infinitive + -ía endings: iríamos
questions.hint: Add the conditional ending for nosotros to the infinitive ir

questions.text: What does «el hermano» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.sister: Sister is la hermana; -o shows it is male

questions.solution: El hermano = the brother
questions.hint: Think of the boys in a family

questions.text: What does «la abuela» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.grandfather: Grandfather is el abuelo; the -a ending shows a woman
feedback.grandpa: Grandpa is el abuelo; the -a ending shows a woman
feedback.grandad: Grandad is el abuelo; the -a ending shows a woman

questions.solution: La abuela = the grandmother (el abuelo = the grandfather)
questions.hint: She is your mother's or father's mother

questions.text: Which is the Spanish for «uncle»?
questions.solution: El tío = uncle; la tía = aunt, el primo = cousin, el sobrino = nephew
questions.hint: It is the masculine form of tía

questions.text: What does «el bombero» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: El bombero = the firefighter
questions.hint: This person puts out fires

questions.text: Which word means «tired»?
questions.solution: Cansado = tired; contento = happy, enfermo = ill, enfadado = angry
questions.hint: Think of how you feel after a long day

questions.text: What does «el desayuno» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: El desayuno = breakfast (desayunar = to have breakfast)
questions.hint: It's the first meal of the day

questions.text: Which word means «funny»?
questions.solution: Gracioso = funny; tímido = shy, perezoso = lazy, serio = serious
questions.hint: This person makes you laugh

questions.text: False friend! What does «la carpeta» mean in English? Answer in English.

feedback.carpet: False friend: a carpet is una alfombra; la carpeta is for keeping papers in

questions.solution: La carpeta = the folder (a carpet is una alfombra)
questions.hint: You keep your school papers in it

questions.text: What is the feminine form of «trabajador» (hard-working)?
questions.solution: Adjectives ending in -or add -a in the feminine: trabajadora
questions.hint: Adjectives ending in -or add one letter in the feminine

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include the definite article (el, la, los or las): the hand

feedback.el mano: Mano is an exception: it ends in -o but is feminine

questions.solution: Mano is feminine even though it ends in -o: la mano
questions.hint: This noun is an exception: it ends in -o but is feminine

questions.text: Which sentence means «I get up at seven o'clock»?

feedback: Me acuesto means I go to bed
Me despierto means I wake up, not I get up
Me visto means I get dressed

questions.solution: Levantarse = to get up; despertarse = to wake up, acostarse = to go to bed, vestirse = to get dressed
questions.hint: Which reflexive verb means to get out of bed?

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include «un» or «una»: a nurse (a woman)

feedback.un enfermero: Un enfermero is a male nurse

questions.solution: Enfermero becomes enfermera for a woman: una enfermera
questions.hint: Start from the word for a male nurse and make it feminine

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Mi padre ___ alto y delgado.»

feedback: Estar is for temporary states and location
Son goes with a plural subject

questions.solution: Permanent physical description uses ser: mi padre es alto y delgado
questions.hint: Ser or estar? Height is a permanent characteristic

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «Tengo ___ ojos azules.» (I have blue eyes)
questions.solution: Ojos is masculine plural: tengo los ojos azules
questions.hint: Ojo is masculine, and here it is plural

questions.text: What does «Mi padre es más alto que mi madre» mean?

options: My father is older than my mother
My mother is taller than my father
My father is as tall as my mother
My father is taller than my mother

questions.solution: Más alto que = taller than: my father is taller than my mother
questions.hint: Más ... que makes a comparison: more ... than

questions.text: Read: «Mi hermana es muy habladora.» What is the sister like? Answer in English with one word.
questions.solution: Habladora = chatty or talkative (hablar = to speak)
questions.hint: It comes from the verb hablar

questions.text: Read: «Mi tía es abogada.» What is the aunt's job? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Abogada = lawyer (a woman); abogado for a man
questions.hint: She works in courts

questions.text: What does «Tengo que ordenar mi dormitorio» mean?

options: I have to tidy my bedroom
I want to tidy my bedroom

questions.solution: Tener que + infinitive = to have to: I have to tidy my bedroom
questions.hint: Tener que means to have to

questions.text: Read: «Para llevar una vida sana, como fruta y no fumo.» What does the speaker do to stay healthy?

options: Eats fruit and does not smoke
Drinks water and does not smoke

questions.solution: Como fruta = I eat fruit; no fumo = I don't smoke
questions.hint: Find the two verbs: como and fumo

questions.text: Read: «Por la mañana, me ducho y bebo té.» What does the speaker drink in the morning? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Bebo té = I drink tea
questions.hint: It's a hot drink, often served with milk in Britain

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «levantarse»: «Mi hermano ___ a las ocho.» Type the two missing words.

feedback.me levanto: Me levanto is for yo; mi hermano needs the él form
feedback.se levantó: Levantó is the preterite (he got up)
feedback.levanta: Reflexive verbs need their pronoun (se with él)

questions.solution: Reflexive verb with él: se levanta
questions.hint: Use the reflexive pronoun for él, then the él form of levantar

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Mi hermana ___ ser médica.» (wants to)

feedback: Quiero goes with yo
Quieren goes with ellos/ellas

questions.solution: Querer (e→ie) with ella: quiere
questions.hint: Mi hermana = ella; which form of querer goes with ella?

questions.text: Complete with the correct form of «simpático»: «Mis primas son muy ___.» Type the adjective only.
questions.solution: Primas is feminine plural: simpáticas
questions.hint: Primas is feminine and plural

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «El año que viene, mi hermano ___ a la universidad.» (will go)

feedback: Iría is the conditional (would go)
Iba is the imperfect
Fue is the preterite

questions.solution: Future of ir with él: irá
questions.hint: El año que viene = next year

questions.text: Complete with the imperfect of «ser»: «Cuando ___ pequeño, vivía en Madrid.» (yo) Type the verb only.

feedback.fui: Fui is the preterite; descriptions in the past use the imperfect

questions.solution: Ser is irregular in the imperfect: yo era
questions.hint: Ser has an irregular imperfect; this is the yo form

questions.text: Choose the correct form of «despertarse»: «Esta mañana me ___ a las seis.»

feedback: Despierto is the present
Despertaré is the future

questions.solution: A single finished action this morning uses the preterite: me desperté
questions.hint: Esta mañana describes one finished action in the past

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
questions.solution: Padres is masculine plural: son simpáticos
questions.hint: Check the verb and the adjective ending

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «When I am older, I would like to be a vet»?

options: Cuando era mayor, me gustaba ser veterinario
Cuando sea mayor, me gustaría ser veterinario

questions.solution: Cuando + subjunctive (sea) talks about the future, and me gustaría means I would like
questions.hint: Look for the conditional of gustar

questions.text: Which negative sentence is correct?
questions.solution: Nunca goes before the reflexive pronoun and the verb: nunca me acuesto tarde
questions.hint: The reflexive pronoun stays right in front of the verb

questions.text: Translate into Spanish: «she is tall and nice»

feedback.ella es alto y simpático: Both adjectives must be feminine to agree with ella
feedback.es alto y simpático: Both adjectives must be feminine to agree with ella
feedback.ella está alta y simpática: Descriptions of character and looks use ser
feedback.ella es alta y simpático: Simpático must agree with ella too

questions.solution: Both adjectives agree with ella: alta, simpática; descriptions use ser
questions.hint: Use ser and make both adjectives feminine

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using ir a + infinitive: «I am going to work»

feedback.trabajaré: That is the simple future; this question asks for ir a + infinitive
feedback.voy trabajar: You need a between voy and the infinitive

questions.solution: Near future: voy a + infinitive trabajar
questions.hint: Use the yo form of ir, then a, then the infinitive

questions.text: Translate into Spanish: «my brothers are lazy»

feedback.mi hermano es perezoso: That is singular (my brother is lazy)

questions.solution: Masculine plural: mis hermanos son perezosos
questions.hint: Plural possessive, ser in the ellos form and a masculine plural adjective

questions.text: What does «la natación» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La natación = swimming (nadar = to swim)
questions.hint: It's a sport you do in a pool

questions.text: What does «el queso» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: El queso = cheese
questions.hint: Manchego is a famous Spanish one

questions.text: Which is the Spanish for «the mobile phone»?
questions.solution: El móvil = the mobile phone; el ordenador = the computer, la tableta = the tablet, el mando = the remote control
questions.hint: Think of a phone you carry around: it moves with you

questions.text: What does «el ajedrez» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Jugar al ajedrez = to play chess
questions.hint: A board game with kings, queens and knights

questions.text: Which word means «the cake»?
questions.solution: La tarta (or el pastel) = the cake; el pan = bread, el pescado = fish, el pollo = chicken
questions.hint: You might have one with candles on your birthday

questions.text: What does «la canción» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La canción = the song (cantar = to sing)
questions.hint: It's related to cantar, to sing

questions.text: Which word means «Christmas»?
questions.solution: La Navidad = Christmas; Semana Santa = Easter week, el cumpleaños = birthday, Nochevieja = New Year's Eve
questions.hint: It is celebrated on 25 December

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Mi hermano ___ la guitarra.» (plays)

feedback: Jugar is used for sports and games, not instruments

questions.solution: Instruments use tocar: toca la guitarra; sports and games use jugar
questions.hint: Spanish uses different verbs for instruments and for sports

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «Juego ___ fútbol.»

feedback: Fútbol is masculine, so a la is wrong
Del means of the or from the

questions.solution: Jugar is followed by a, and a + el = al: juego al fútbol
questions.hint: Jugar is followed by a; what does a + el become?

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include the definite article (el, la, los or las): the music

feedback.el música: Música is feminine, so it takes la

questions.solution: Música is feminine: la música
questions.hint: Nouns ending in -a are usually feminine

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include the definite article (el, la, los or las): the newspaper

feedback.la periódico: Periódico is masculine, so it takes el

questions.solution: El periódico (or el diario) = the newspaper
questions.hint: It is masculine

questions.text: Which phrase means «cartoons»?
questions.solution: Los dibujos animados = cartoons; la telenovela = soap opera, el concurso = game show, las noticias = the news
questions.hint: Animados suggests animation

questions.text: What does «las noticias» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Las noticias = the news
questions.hint: A programme about what happened in the world today

questions.text: Choose the correct word: «Me gusta ___ cine.»

feedback: Al means to the; gustar needs the article el

questions.solution: With gustar, Spanish uses the definite article: me gusta el cine
questions.hint: Cine is masculine singular

questions.text: What does «Prefiero ver películas de terror» mean?
questions.solution: Prefiero = I prefer; películas de terror = horror films
questions.hint: Prefiero looks like an English verb

questions.text: Read: «Los sábados voy a la piscina con mi hermana.» On which day does the speaker go to the pool? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Los sábados = on Saturdays
questions.hint: It's the day before domingo

questions.text: Read: «Mi plato favorito es el pollo asado.» What is the speaker's favourite dish? Answer in English.
questions.solution: El pollo asado = roast chicken
questions.hint: Pollo is a bird you eat; asado is a way of cooking it

questions.text: What does «Paso demasiado tiempo en las redes sociales» mean?

options: I spend too much time on social media
I spend very little time on social media
I spent a long time on my phone

questions.solution: Pasar tiempo = to spend time; demasiado = too much; las redes sociales = social media
questions.hint: Demasiado means too much

questions.text: Read: «Para mi cumpleaños, mis padres me regalaron una guitarra.» What present did the speaker get? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Una guitarra = a guitar
questions.hint: It's a musical instrument with strings

questions.text: Read: «No me gusta el rap, pero me encanta el jazz.» Which statement is true?

options: The speaker likes both rap and jazz

questions.solution: No me gusta el rap = I don't like rap; me encanta el jazz = I love jazz
questions.hint: Pero (but) separates the two opinions

questions.text: Complete with the preterite of «ver»: «El fin de semana pasado ___ una película muy buena.» (nosotros) Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Ver in the preterite: vi, viste, vio, vimos, visteis, vieron
questions.hint: In the preterite, ver has no written accents; use the nosotros ending for -er verbs

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Mañana ___ al tenis con mis amigos.» (yo)

feedback: Jugaba is the imperfect
Jugué is the preterite
Jugarán goes with ellos/ellas

questions.solution: Mañana points to the future: jugaré
questions.hint: Which tense goes with mañana, and which ending goes with yo?

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «hacer»: «Los domingos ___ deporte con mi padre.» (yo) Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Hacer is irregular in the yo form: hago
questions.hint: Hacer has an irregular yo form with a g

questions.text: Choose the correct pronoun: «¿Te gustan las patatas fritas? — Sí, ___ como mucho.»

feedback: Los replaces a masculine plural noun
Les is an indirect pronoun (to them)

questions.solution: Las patatas fritas is feminine plural: las como
questions.hint: Patatas is feminine plural

questions.text: Complete with the imperfect of «ver»: «Antes ___ la tele todas las noches.» (yo) Type the verb only.

feedback.vi: Vi is the preterite; a past habit uses the imperfect

questions.solution: Ver is irregular in the imperfect: yo veía
questions.hint: Antes + todas las noches describes a past habit

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «Es un ___ programa.» (great)
questions.solution: Before a singular noun, grande shortens to gran: un gran programa
questions.hint: Grande changes form when it comes before a singular noun

questions.text: Which sentence about last night is correct?
questions.solution: Anoche needs the preterite (fuimos), and a + el = al
questions.hint: Check the tense and the contraction

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «I don't like playing video games»?

options: No me gusto jugar a los videojuegos
Me no gusta jugar a los videojuegos
No me gusta jugar a los videojuegos
No me gusta jugando a los videojuegos

questions.solution: No goes before me gusta, and gustar is followed by the infinitive
questions.hint: Gustar is followed by an infinitive, not an -ing form

questions.text: Which sentence with «si» (if) is correct?

options: Si tendría dinero, compraría una consola
Si tengo dinero, compraría una consola
Si tuviera dinero, compraré una consola
Si tuviera dinero, compraría una consola

questions.solution: Si + imperfect subjunctive (tuviera), then the conditional (compraría)
questions.hint: After si, Spanish never uses the conditional

questions.text: Translate into Spanish: «I play the guitar»
questions.solution: Instruments use tocar: toco la guitarra
questions.hint: Spanish uses a special verb for playing instruments

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using the preterite: «she watched a film»

feedback.veía una película: Veía is the imperfect (she used to watch)
feedback.ella veía una película: Veía is the imperfect (she used to watch)

questions.solution: Ver in the preterite with ella: vio (no accent)
questions.hint: Use the preterite of ver for ella

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using ir a + infinitive: «we are going to eat paella»

feedback.vamos comer paella: You need a between vamos and the infinitive
feedback.comeremos paella: That is the simple future; this question asks for ir a + infinitive

questions.solution: Near future: vamos a + the infinitive comer
questions.hint: Use the nosotros form of ir, then a, then the infinitive

questions.text: What does «la playa» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La playa = the beach
questions.hint: You find sand and the sea there

questions.text: What does «la estación de tren» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La estación de tren = the train station
questions.hint: You catch the train there

questions.text: Which is the Spanish for «it is raining»?
questions.solution: Llueve = it is raining; nieva = it is snowing, hace sol = it is sunny, hace viento = it is windy
questions.hint: Think of the verb llover

questions.text: What does «la panadería» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La panadería = the bakery (el pan = bread)
questions.hint: It comes from pan, bread

questions.text: Which word means «the plane»?
questions.solution: El avión = the plane; el barco = the boat, el coche = the car, el autocar = the coach
questions.hint: You get on it at an airport

questions.text: What does «el ayuntamiento» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: El ayuntamiento = the town hall (or the town council)
questions.hint: The mayor (el alcalde) works there

questions.text: Which word means «the bedroom»?
questions.solution: El dormitorio = the bedroom; la cocina = the kitchen, el cuarto de baño = the bathroom, el salón = the living room
questions.hint: It comes from dormir, to sleep

questions.text: False friend! What does «la librería» mean?

feedback: False friend: the library is la biblioteca

questions.solution: False friend: la librería is a bookshop; a library is la biblioteca
questions.hint: It's a false friend: think about where you buy books

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include the definite article (el, la, los or las): the library

feedback.la librería: La librería is a bookshop (false friend)
feedback.el biblioteca: Biblioteca is feminine, so it takes la

questions.solution: La biblioteca = the library; la librería is a bookshop
questions.hint: It's feminine and it is not the false friend librería

questions.text: Choose the correct phrase: «El banco está ___ la farmacia.» (next to)

feedback: Enfrente de means opposite
Detrás de means behind

questions.solution: Al lado de = next to; enfrente de = opposite, detrás de = behind, debajo de = under
questions.hint: Lado means side

questions.text: Translate into Spanish. Include the definite article (el, la, los or las): the car

feedback.la coche: Coche is masculine, so it takes el

questions.solution: El coche = the car (el carro or el auto in Latin America)
questions.hint: It is masculine

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence: «I live in London.»

feedback: A shows movement towards a place (voy a Londres)
De means from or of

questions.solution: Living in a place uses en: vivo en Londres
questions.hint: Which preposition means in?

questions.text: What does «las afueras» mean in English? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Las afueras = the outskirts of a town
questions.hint: It comes from fuera, outside

questions.text: Which phrase means «on the left»?

feedback: A la derecha means on the right
Todo recto means straight on

questions.solution: A la izquierda = on the left; a la derecha = on the right, todo recto = straight on, enfrente = opposite
questions.hint: It is the opposite of a la derecha

questions.text: What does «Hace calor y hace sol» mean?
questions.solution: Hace calor = it is hot; hace sol = it is sunny
questions.hint: Calor is linked to heat

questions.text: Read: «Voy al instituto en bici.» How does the speaker travel to school? Answer in English.
questions.solution: En bici = by bike
questions.hint: It has two wheels and pedals

questions.text: Read: «El verano pasado fui a Italia con mi familia.» Which country did the speaker visit? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Italia = Italy
questions.hint: Its capital is Rome

questions.text: What does «La estación está enfrente del banco» mean?

options: The station is opposite the bank
The station is next to the bank
The station is behind the bank
The bank is opposite the post office

questions.solution: Enfrente de = opposite: the station is opposite the bank
questions.hint: Enfrente de is a preposition of place: think of facing something

questions.text: Read: «En mi ciudad hay demasiada contaminación.» What problem does the town have? Answer in English.
questions.solution: La contaminación = pollution
questions.hint: It is bad for the air and for the environment

questions.text: Read: «Para proteger el medio ambiente, reciclo y voy en autobús.» What does the speaker do?

options: Saves water and takes the bus
Turns off the lights and recycles

questions.solution: Reciclo = I recycle; voy en autobús = I go by bus
questions.hint: Find the two verbs after para proteger el medio ambiente

questions.text: Complete with the preterite of «salir»: «Mis padres ___ de vacaciones ayer.» Type the verb only.
questions.solution: Salir in the preterite with ellos: salieron
questions.hint: Use the regular -ir preterite ending for ellos

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Si hace buen tiempo mañana, ___ a la playa.» (nosotros)

feedback: Iríamos is the conditional; it goes with si + imperfect subjunctive
Fuimos is the preterite

questions.solution: Si + present, then future: iremos
questions.hint: Si + present tense is followed by the future

questions.text: Complete with the present tense of «volver»: «Mi padre ___ a casa a las seis.» Type the verb only.

feedback.volve: Volver is stem-changing: o becomes ue

questions.solution: Volver changes o→ue: él vuelve
questions.hint: Volver is a stem-changing verb: the o changes in the él form

questions.text: Choose the correct adjective: «Vivo en una casa muy ___.» (pretty)
questions.solution: Casa is feminine singular: bonita
questions.hint: Casa is feminine

questions.text: Complete with the imperfect of «hacer»: «Durante las vacaciones, ___ mucho calor.» Type the verb only.

feedback.hizo: Hizo is the preterite; this question asks for the imperfect

questions.solution: Imperfect of hacer for describing the weather: hacía
questions.hint: Use the imperfect -er ending for él

questions.text: Choose the correct pronoun: «¿Compraste la camiseta? — Sí, ___ compré ayer.»

feedback: Lo replaces a masculine noun
Le is an indirect pronoun (to him / to her)

questions.solution: La camiseta is feminine singular: la compré
questions.hint: Camiseta is feminine and it is the direct object

questions.text: Which sentence about last year is correct?

options: El año pasado vamos a España
El año pasado fuimos a España
El año pasado fuimos en España
El año pasado iremos a España

questions.solution: El año pasado needs the preterite (fuimos), and going to a country uses a
questions.hint: Check the tense and the preposition

questions.text: Which is the correct translation of «We must protect the planet»?
questions.solution: Deber + infinitive: debemos proteger; planeta is masculine (el planeta)
questions.hint: After deber, the next verb is an infinitive

questions.text: Read: «Antes había un cine en mi pueblo, pero ahora ya no hay nada.» Which statement is true?

options: There is a new cinema in the village
There has never been a cinema in the village
The cinema is going to close soon
There used to be a cinema, but now there is nothing

questions.solution: Había = there was / there used to be; ya no hay nada = there is nothing any more
questions.hint: Compare the imperfect había with the present hay

questions.text: Translate into Spanish: «I went to the beach»

feedback.iba a la playa: Iba is the imperfect (I used to go / I was going)
feedback.fui al playa: Playa is feminine, so a la, not al

questions.solution: Preterite of ir (fui) + a la playa
questions.hint: Use the preterite of ir; playa is feminine

questions.text: Translate into Spanish using the future tense: «it will rain»

feedback.va a llover: That is ir a + infinitive; this question asks for the future tense
feedback.llovería: Llovería is the conditional (it would rain)

questions.solution: Future of llover: lloverá
questions.hint: Add the future ending for él to the infinitive

questions.text: Translate into Spanish: «there is a lot of traffic»
questions.solution: Hay = there is; tráfico is masculine: mucho tráfico
questions.hint: Use hay, and make the word for a lot agree with a masculine noun
